dedupe_keys.name: an open source optimization model for open pit mine production scheduling

description: Gilbert Yaw Bimpong, Justina Senam Lotsu and Kwaku Boakye publish a Python mine-production scheduling model using PuLP and the CBC solver. Its block model includes coordinates, grades, tonnage, costs, recovery factors and environmental penalties. The formulation combines economic, geotechnical and environmental constraints to schedule extraction and report period-level production and value. Zenodo lists the adjusted CSV block model, scheduling code, a block-data generator and a requirements file, free under CC BY 4.0. The April 2026 deposit supports a study of open-pit mine planning; the physical mine, planning-period duration and block resolution remain unknown from the landing page. The provider describes a fixed gold-price assumption, which should be treated as a study parameter, not a current price. The code was not executed. No related catalogue model is explicitly identified.
